newsitem.title: MEXICO: Clinton response to Dow surge: Americans are happy.
newsitem.headline: Clinton response to Dow surge: Americans are happy.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton on Tuesday reacted to the latest U.S. stock market surge by saying it signaled Americans are happy and that the country is on the upswing.
"Americans are happy. They ought to be. The country is doing well, we're going to do better," Clinton told reporters when asked for his reaction to the Dow rally.
He was speaking during a photo opportunity with Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo on the first full day of his first state visit to Mexico.
Last week, the Dow Jones Industrial Average powered through 7,000 points, and it was perched at 7,238.57, up nearly 25 points before midday Tuesday.
When asked if his deal last Friday with Republican leaders in Congress to balance the U.S. budget by the year 2002 helped the stock market, Clinton replied: "Didn't hurt."
Clinton leaves Mexico for Costa Rica on Wednesday.
